summary.lv: IT Camp meklē IT sistēmu administratoru Latvijas lielākajam pārtikas ražošanas uzņēmumam — administrēt Windows/Linux infrastruktūru, Active Directory, MS Azure un tīkla iekārtas.
summary.en: IT Camp is recruiting an IT Systems Administrator for Latvia's largest food production company to manage Windows/Linux infrastructure, Active Directory, MS Azure, and network equipment including Fortigate.
